question: What are the hottest topics in AI right now?
strategy:
1. Called get_trending_ai_papers(max_results=20) → retrieved latest submissions across cs.AI, cs.LG, cs.CL, cs.CV
2. Parsed Atom XML, grouped papers by primary category and keyword clusters in titles
3. Called search_openalex(search='large language model agents 2024', per_page=8) → got citation counts to identify breakout works
4. Cross-referenced: papers with high arXiv submission rate AND high OpenAlex citation count = confirmed hot topic
insights:
ANALYSIS COMPLETE
Data scope: cs.AI, cs.LG, cs.CL, cs.CV | 20 recent papers + 8 OpenAlex works | last 7 days
Key findings:
• LLM agent frameworks (tool-use, planning, memory) dominate recent submissions — 8 of 20 papers
• Multimodal models (vision-language) fast-growing: 5 papers in cs.CV crossing into cs.CL
• RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) has high citation velocity on OpenAlex — 3 works >500 citations in <6 months
Trends: Shift from model training papers toward inference-time improvements (agents, RAG, prompt optimisation)
Confidence: High — broad dataset covering all major AI sub-fields

question: How active is research on transformer architectures compared to graph neural networks?
strategy:
1. Called search_papers(search_query='all:transformer architecture', max_results=10, sortBy='submittedDate') → recent transformer papers
2. Called search_papers(search_query='all:graph neural network', max_results=10, sortBy='submittedDate') → recent GNN papers
3. Called search_openalex(search='transformer architecture deep learning', per_page=5) → citation counts for transformers
4. Called search_openalex(search='graph neural network', per_page=5) → citation counts for GNNs
5. Compared submission recency and citation totals across both topics
insights:
ANALYSIS COMPLETE
Data scope: transformers vs GNNs | 20 arXiv papers + 10 OpenAlex works | 2024
Key findings:
• Transformer submissions outnumber GNN ~4:1 in recent arXiv activity
• OpenAlex: transformer papers average 3x more citations than GNN papers at same age
• GNN research increasingly applied (drug discovery, molecular modelling) rather than foundational
Trends: Transformers remain dominant for NLP/vision; GNNs carving out specialist applied niches
Confidence: Medium — snapshot analysis; full trend requires longer time window
